```{r}
#Summary Stats Table
# One row per respondent
data_sub <- data |>
  select(record_id, survey_type, gender, age,
         annual_income, birth_location, children_HH) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(
    age            = as.numeric(age),
    children_HH    = as.numeric(children_HH),
    gender_female  = as.integer(gender == 2),
    okinawa        = as.integer(birth_location == 1),
    income         = as.numeric(annual_income),
    # revised income
    income_revised = if_else(income == 6, NA_real_, income)
  )

summary_table <- data_sub |>
  group_by(survey_type) |>
  summarise(
    n                    = n(),
    n_income_revised     = sum(!is.na(income_revised)),
    Gender_mean          = mean(gender_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    Gender_sd            = sd(gender_female, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_mean             = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Age_sd               = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Income_mean          = mean(income, na.rm = TRUE),
    Income_sd            = sd(income, na.rm = TRUE),
    IncomeRev_mean       = mean(income_revised, na.rm = TRUE),
    IncomeRev_sd         = sd(income_revised, na.rm = TRUE),
    Okinawa_pct          = mean(okinawa, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Children_mean        = mean(children_HH, na.rm = TRUE),
    Children_sd          = sd(children_HH, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

formatted_summary <- summary_table |>
  transmute(
    survey_type,
    Gender             = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", Gender_mean, Gender_sd),
    Age                = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", Age_mean, Age_sd),
    Income             = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", Income_mean, Income_sd),
    `Income (revised)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", IncomeRev_mean, IncomeRev_sd),
    Okinawa            = sprintf("%.0f%%", Okinawa_pct),
    Children           = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", Children_mean, Children_sd)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-survey_type, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = unique(Variable))) |>  # keep row order
  pivot_wider(names_from = survey_type, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(Variable = as.character(Variable)) |>
  # survey_type 1 = national, 2 = community (named, not positional)
  rename(`National Based MPA management regime Survey`  = `1`,
         `Community Based MPA management regime Survey` = `2`)

n_valid <- summary_table$n_income_revised
n_all   <- summary_table$n

formatted_summary |>
  kable(escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling() |>
  row_spec(which(formatted_summary$Variable == "Income (revised)"), bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = c(
    "Cells show mean (standard deviation); Okinawa is the percent born in Okinawa.",
    "Income keeps code 6 ('don't know / prefer not to answer') as the number 6, which is how the paper's Table 2 is reproduced.",
    sprintf("Income (revised) sets code 6 to missing. Valid income responses: %d of %d (national), %d of %d (community).",
            n_valid[1], n_all[1], n_valid[2], n_all[2])),
    general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#Randomized Stuff
set.seed(0215)  # Seeding for replicable results
data_choice <- data |>
  mutate(across(c(record_id, survey_type, Cid, ASC, record_iidd,
                  fish_catch, coral_coverage, coastal_conditions, contribution),
                as.numeric)) |>
  arrange(Cid, desc(ASC), record_iidd) |>   # puts default last
  group_by(Cid) |>
  mutate(alt           = row_number(),                          # 1, 2 = MPA options; 3 = status quo
         choice_random = as.integer(alt == sample(n(), 1))) |>  # one random choice per question
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(community   = as.integer(survey_type == 2),            # 1 = community based
         choice_real = as.integer(Choice))                      # observed choice

# fact check code
stopifnot(
  all(count(data_choice, Cid)$n == 3),
  all(summarise(group_by(data_choice, Cid), k = sum(choice_random))$k == 1),
  all(summarise(group_by(data_choice, Cid), k = sum(choice_real))$k == 1),
  all(data_choice$ASC[data_choice$alt == 3] == 0),
  all(data_choice$alt == data_choice$Alt)   )

```

```{r}
#actual model time
make_mdata <- function(df, choice_col) {
  model_df <- df |>
    transmute(
      Cid = as.integer(Cid), record_id = as.integer(record_id), alt = as.integer(alt),
      choice             = as.logical(.data[[choice_col]]),
      fish_catch         = as.numeric(fish_catch),
      coral_coverage     = as.numeric(coral_coverage),
      coastal_conditions = as.numeric(coastal_conditions),
      payment            = as.numeric(contribution),
      ASC                = as.numeric(ASC),
      community          = as.numeric(community),
      fish_comm          = fish_catch * community,
      coral_comm         = coral_coverage * community,
      coastal_comm       = coastal_conditions * community,
      pay_comm           = payment * community,
      ASC_comm           = ASC * community
    ) |>
    as.data.frame()
  # panel structure: choice situation (Cid) nested within respondent (record_id)
  dfidx(model_df, idx = list(c("Cid", "record_id"), "alt"))
}

# Model formulas
f1 <- choice ~ fish_catch + coral_coverage + coastal_conditions + payment + ASC | -1
f2 <- choice ~ fish_catch + coral_coverage + coastal_conditions + payment + ASC +
  fish_comm + coral_comm + coastal_comm + pay_comm + ASC_comm | -1

rpar1 <- c(fish_catch = "n", coral_coverage = "n", coastal_conditions = "n",
           payment = "n", ASC = "n")
rpar2 <- c(rpar1, fish_comm = "n", coral_comm = "n", coastal_comm = "n",
           pay_comm = "n", ASC_comm = "n")

# m0 = basic 
# m1 = Model 1 (mixed logit, main effects)
# m2 = Model 2 (mixed logit, main effects + community interactions)

fit_models <- function(mdata) {
  m0 <- mlogit(f1, data = mdata)
  b0 <- coef(m0)

  m1 <- mlogit(f1, data = mdata, rpar = rpar1,
               R = 500, halton = NA, panel = TRUE,
               start = c(b0, abs(b0) / 2))          # means, then sds
  b1 <- coef(m1)
  means1 <- b1[1:5]
  sds1   <- abs(b1[6:10])

  m2 <- mlogit(f2, data = mdata, rpar = rpar2,
               R = 500, halton = NA, panel = TRUE,
               start = c(means1, rep(0, 5),          # means: main effects, interactions
                         sds1, sds1 / 2))            # sds:   main effects, interactions
  stopifnot(as.numeric(logLik(m1)) >= as.numeric(logLik(m0)) - 1e-6,
            as.numeric(logLik(m2)) >= as.numeric(logLik(m1)) - 1e-6)
  list(m0 = m0, m1 = m1, m2 = m2)
}

mdata_real   <- make_mdata(data_choice, "choice_real")
mdata_random <- make_mdata(data_choice, "choice_random")
```

```{r}
# Observed-choice models 
models_real <- fit_models(mdata_real)
```

```{r}
# Randomized-choice models 
models_random <- fit_models(mdata_random)
```

```{r}
var_labels <- c(
  fish_catch         = "Fish Catch",
  coral_coverage     = "Coral Coverage",
  coastal_conditions = "Coastal Development Restrictions",
  payment            = "Payment",
  ASC                = "ASC",
  fish_comm          = "Fish Catch (Community based MPA)",
  coral_comm         = "Coral Coverage (Community based MPA)",
  coastal_comm       = "Coastal Development Restrictions (Community based MPA)",
  pay_comm           = "Payment (Community based MPA)",
  ASC_comm           = "ASC (Community based MPA)"
)

sig_stars <- function(p) case_when(p < 0.01 ~ "***", p < 0.05 ~ "**", p < 0.10 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "")

n_resp <- length(unique(data_choice$record_id))
n_cs   <- length(unique(data_choice$Cid))

results_table <- function(model, paper = NULL, placeholder = FALSE) {
  ct <- summary(model)$CoefTable
  k  <- nrow(ct) / 2                      # k means followed by k standard deviations
  stars <- sig_stars
  has_paper <- !is.null(paper)
  mean_ct <- ct[1:k, , drop = FALSE]
  sd_ct   <- ct[(k + 1):(2 * k), , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(paste0("sd.", rownames(mean_ct)), rownames(sd_ct)))
  if (has_paper) stopifnot(all(rownames(mean_ct) %in% names(paper)))

  # Each variable takes two table rows
  coef_top <- function(m) paste0(formatC(m[, 1], format = "f", digits = 4), stars(m[, 4]))
  se_below <- function(m) paste0("(", formatC(m[, 2], format = "f", digits = 4), ")")
  stack    <- function(top, below) as.vector(rbind(top, below))

  tab <- data.frame(Variable = stack(unname(var_labels[rownames(mean_ct)]),
                                     rep("", k)),
                    check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
  if (has_paper) {
    # the paper's cells are stored as "coef*** (SE)": split into the two lines
    p <- unname(paper[rownames(mean_ct)])
    tab[["Paper"]] <- stack(sub(" \\(.*$", "", p), sub("^.* ", "", p))
  }
  tab[["Replication"]] <- stack(coef_top(mean_ct), se_below(mean_ct))
  tab[["Replication "]] <- stack(coef_top(sd_ct),  se_below(sd_ct))   # standard deviations
  names(tab) <- c("Variable", if (has_paper) "Paper", "Replication", "Replication")

  n_mean_cols <- 1 + has_paper            # columns in the "Coefficient (mean)" block
  sd_first    <- 2 + n_mean_cols          # position of the standard-deviation column

  notes <- c(
    paste0("Respondents: ", n_resp, ". Choice situations: ", n_cs, "."),
    "Standard errors are in parentheses under each coefficient. * p < 0.10, ** p < 0.05, *** p < 0.01. All coefficients are random normal. Payment is in yen per month.")
  if (has_paper) {
    notes <- c(notes,
      "Paper: coefficients and standard errors as printed in Table 3 of Shah et al. (2019), PLOS ONE 14(3): e0213354 (827 respondents). The paper's standard deviations are not shown here.")
  }
  if (placeholder) {
    notes <- c(notes,
      "CAUTION: the choice variable is randomly generated, so these estimates are placeholders for comparison only.")
  }

  tab |>
    kable(row.names = FALSE,
          align = paste0("l", strrep("c", n_mean_cols + 1))) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 14) |>
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Coefficient (mean)" = n_mean_cols, "Standard deviation" = 1),
                     bold = TRUE) |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1.5px solid #333333;") |>
    column_spec(sd_first, border_left = TRUE) |>
    footnote(general = notes, general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = FALSE)
}

```

```{r}
# Delta-method WTP: ratio -(sum of `num` coefficients) / (sum of `den` coefficients)
wtp_est <- function(model, num, den) {
  b <- coef(model)
  V <- vcov(model)
  stopifnot(all(c(num, den) %in% names(b)))
  a <- sum(b[num])
  d <- sum(b[den])
  g <- setNames(rep(0, length(b)), names(b))   # gradient of -a/d wrt every parameter
  g[num] <- -1 / d
  g[den] <- a / d^2
  c(est = unname(-a / d), se = sqrt(as.numeric(t(g) %*% V[names(g), names(g)] %*% g)))
}

fmt_wtp <- function(r, digits) {
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(r[["est"]] / r[["se"]]))
  sprintf("%.*f%s (%.*f)", digits, r[["est"]], sig_stars(p), digits, r[["se"]])
}

wtp_vars   <- c(ASC = "ASC", fish_catch = "Fish Catch", coral_coverage = "Coral Coverage",
                coastal_conditions = "Coastal Development Restrictions")
comm_names <- c(ASC = "ASC_comm", fish_catch = "fish_comm",
                coral_coverage = "coral_comm", coastal_conditions = "coastal_comm")
wtp_dig    <- c(ASC = 1, fish_catch = 3, coral_coverage = 3, coastal_conditions = 3)

w1 <- models_real$m1
w2 <- models_real$m2

wtp_m1_nat <- sapply(names(wtp_vars), function(v)
  fmt_wtp(wtp_est(w1, v, "payment"), wtp_dig[[v]]))
wtp_m2_nat <- sapply(names(wtp_vars), function(v)
  fmt_wtp(wtp_est(w2, v, "payment"), wtp_dig[[v]]))
wtp_m2_com <- sapply(names(wtp_vars), function(v)
  fmt_wtp(wtp_est(w2, c(v, comm_names[[v]]), c("payment", "pay_comm")), wtp_dig[[v]]))

wtp_top   <- function(x) sub(" \\(.*$", "", x)
wtp_below <- function(x) ifelse(x == "", "", sub("^.* ", "", x))
wtp_stack <- function(x) as.vector(rbind(wtp_top(x), wtp_below(x)))

wtp_labels <- c(unname(wtp_vars), paste0(wtp_vars, " (Community based MPA)"))
wtp_tab <- data.frame(
  Variable = as.vector(rbind(wtp_labels, "")),
  m1       = wtp_stack(c(unname(wtp_m1_nat), rep("", 4))),
  p1       = wtp_stack(c(paper_wtp_m1, rep("", 4))),
  m2       = wtp_stack(c(unname(wtp_m2_nat), unname(wtp_m2_com))),
  p2       = wtp_stack(paper_wtp_m2),
  check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL
)
names(wtp_tab) <- c("Variable", rep(c("Replication", "Paper"), 2))

wtp_tab |>
  kable(row.names = FALSE, align = "lcccc") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 14) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Model 1" = 2, "Model 2" = 2), bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1.5px solid #333333;") |>
  row_spec(9, extra_css = "border-top: 1px solid #999999;") |>   # first community row
  column_spec(4, border_left = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = c(
    paste0("Respondents: ", n_resp, ". Choice situations: ", n_cs, "."),
    "Standard errors are in parentheses under each WTP estimate. WTP is in yen per month for a 1% change in the attribute (ASC: yen per month for having an MPA). 100 yen is about 0.85 USD.",
    "* p < 0.10, ** p < 0.05, *** p < 0.01, from a normal approximation to the delta-method standard error.",
    "Paper: Table 4 of Shah et al. (2019), PLOS ONE 14(3): e0213354. Model 1 has no community rows because it has no management interactions."),
    general_title = "Note: ", footnote_as_chunk = FALSE)
```
